system.description:
When you grant an ally temp HP, they also gain +INT Armor for as long as the temp HP lasts. Additionally, Stim Pack no longer applies Dazed when it ends.

[A] When temp HP from you (your Med Kit, gadgets or Healing Turret) is applied to an ally from the chat card, the ally gets a "Potent Concoction (+INT Armor)" feature that the module removes when their temp HP runs out (Undo card; delete it by hand to correct it).

[M] Stim Pack's Dazed is not automated — just skip it.
